The Console de contrôle stands at the Venture Co. research site west of the Sludge Fen. Close the three valves around the drill, use the console again, then take the Clé de la console from Artisan Sniggles beside it. Careful: Several guards stand within aggro range of the valves, respawn in under about 3 minutes, and run at low health to bring back help; nearby mobs also join if you use a valve while they are close.
